question: Will any of these AI companies (Lovable, DeepSeek, or Perplexity) have a funding round in November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Resolves on Tracxn listing a round dated Nov 2026 for Lovable, DeepSeek, or Perplexity. DeepSeek's ~$15B round was reported as finalized in late Oct 2026, so Tracxn likely dates it October; a November-dated entry (filing, tranche, late announcement) is possible but not likely (~10%). Perplexity's Nvidia-involved round at >$30B has been in talks since late Aug 2026 and was reportedly still unclosed as of late Oct; a Nov close or announcement is ~20-25%. Lovable raised its Series C on Aug 12, 2026, with no new talks found (~6%). Tracxn also lists rumoured and secondary rounds, which raises the odds slightly. No matching human market was found; the Polymarket Perplexity acquisition (6%) and bankruptcy (4%) markets are near-miss contracts I did not use as anchors.
